text:
alex: Quick "version zipper" sweep before RC cut — syncing package tags, changelog and upgrade notes. Target cut 18:00 UTC. Can owners confirm version bumps + docs by 16:30? @maria @sana

maria: On it. I'll update the changelog entry for the routing perf change. ETA 16:00.

jamal: PR #472 (model-allocator) is review-ready. If tests are green can we merge soon?

alex: Hold on merge until smoke results land. @sana doing smoke now. Don't force until perf checked.

sana: kicking off smoke suite — looks like ~7m run. will report back.

devops-bot: CI: PR #472 — build passed; integration tests queued.

sana: smoke green but saw ~5% p90 latency bump in synthetic harness. needs context.

jamal: that might be due to kernel-selection tweak. I can revert quant config as a stopgap if needed.

alex: Decision rule: keep if rollback is trivial and docs note the perf tradeoff. @maria please add a caveat in changelog.

maria: added note in CHANGELOG.md and docs/upgrade.md under "Known perf changes" along with rollback steps.

alex: Rollback snippet to include in docs:
```
git checkout release-v0.35
git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>
git push origin release-v0.35
```

alex: tagging @kate for a quick security scan on deps introduced by PR.

kate: running dependency scan now — no critical CVEs. Two low-risk patches; I'll attach advisory lines to the release notes.

alex: QA owners needed for final sign-off: @lee (e2e), @mike (smoke). Please thumbs by 16:45. Quiet window from 17:50-18:10.

lee: e2e job passed on staging. :thumbsup:

mike: smoke confirmed on staging infra. :shipit:  

alex: Thanks team — unless any objections I'll cut RC at 18:00 UTC and push release notes right after. :tada:

maria: Quick follow: I added a short "what to watch for" checklist in the release notes (latency, memory spike repro steps).

jamal: noted, thanks. I'll hold off merges until you post final.

alex: final: I'll post the cut message ~17:58 and set rollback watch for first 30m.
